onb_doc_title.description: Browser tab title of the onboarding page. {1} is the app name

onb_step_aria.description: Screen reader text of the onboarding step dots. {1} is the current step, {2} the total (4)

onb_step1_title.description: Onboarding step 1 heading: pick the groups of sites to block

onb_sites_zero.description: Site count on an onboarding group card when every site of the group is turned off

onb_sites_one.description: Site count on an onboarding group card, exactly one site

onb_sites_many.description: Site count on an onboarding group card. {1} is the number of sites (2 or more)

onb_edit.description: Short button on a selected group card that shows its sites, so some can be turned off

onb_edit_label.description: Screen reader label of the Edit button of a group card. {1} is the group name, e.g. 'Social media'

onb_custom_placeholder.description: Placeholder and label of the input where the user types a site to block (a domain or a full URL)

onb_custom_remove.description: Screen reader label of the remove button on a site the user added. {1} is the domain

onb_privacy.en: Stays in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
onb_privacy.fr: Reste dans ton navigateur. Rien n'est envoyé.
onb_privacy.description: Privacy line at the bottom of onboarding step 1: the choices are kept by Chrome, nothing is sent to any server

onb_pick_one.en: Pick a group or add a site.
onb_pick_one.fr: Choisis un groupe ou ajoute un site.
onb_pick_one.description: Error when continuing onboarding step 1 with nothing to block

onb_step2_title.description: Onboarding step 2 heading: when blocking happens

onb_when_manual.description: Onboarding step 2 choice (the default): sites are blocked only during sessions the user starts

onb_when_schedule.description: Onboarding step 2 choice: recurring weekly time slot

onb_days_label.description: Screen reader label of the weekday toggles in onboarding step 2

onb_from_label.description: Screen reader label of the start time input in onboarding step 2

onb_to_label.description: Screen reader label of the end time input in onboarding step 2

onb_next_day.description: Hint shown when the end time is earlier than the start time (overnight slot)

onb_error_no_day.description: Schedule validation error: no weekday selected

onb_error_same_time.en: Start and end must be different.
onb_error_same_time.fr: Le début et la fin doivent être différents.
onb_error_same_time.description: Schedule validation error: start time equals end time

onb_error_invalid_time.description: Schedule validation error: empty or incomplete time

onb_strict_money.en: To end early: pay what you chose, or type a sentence.
onb_strict_money.fr: Pour arrêter avant : paie ce que tu as choisi, ou tape une phrase.
onb_strict_money.description: One line in onboarding step 2 stating the strict behavior for the money choice of step 4 (also the default before step 4): ending a session early means paying the chosen amount, or typing a sentence for free

onb_strict_free.en: To end early: type a sentence.
onb_strict_free.fr: Pour arrêter avant : tape une phrase.
onb_strict_free.description: Same line in onboarding step 2 once the user picked Free only in step 4: ending a session early means typing a sentence

onb_step3_sub.en: What you're building, not today's to-do. You'll see it when a site is blocked.
onb_step3_sub.fr: Ce que tu construis, pas ta liste du jour. Tu le verras quand un site est bloqué.
onb_step3_sub.description: Line under the goal step title.

onb_goal_label.description: Screen reader label of the goal input

onb_goal_placeholder.description: Example in the custom goal field.

onb_step4_title.en: If you want to stop early
onb_step4_title.fr: Si tu veux arrêter avant la fin
onb_step4_title.description: Title of the step about ending a session early.

onb_step4_sub.en: Stopping should take a moment of thought. Choose what it takes.
onb_step4_sub.fr: Arrêter doit te demander un moment de réflexion. Choisis ce qu'il faudra.

onb_mode_money_sub.en: Ending a session early costs the amount you pick.
onb_mode_money_sub.fr: Arrêter une session avant la fin coûte le montant choisi.

onb_mode_free.description: Onboarding step 4 choice: ending a session early never involves money

onb_mode_free_sub.en: Type a sentence to end a session early.
onb_mode_free_sub.fr: Tu tapes une phrase pour arrêter une session avant la fin.

onb_amount_label.description: Screen reader label of the row of amounts in the money choice

onb_amount_other.description: Last button of the amount row: reveals a field to type any amount

onb_amount_input_label.description: Screen reader label of the field where the user types a custom amount

onb_amount_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the custom amount field, shown next to the currency sign. {1} and {2} are the limits (1 and 500)

onb_amount_error.en: Choose a whole amount from {1} to {2}.
onb_amount_error.fr: Choisis un montant entier entre {1} et {2}.
onb_amount_error.description: Inline error for an invalid custom amount. {1} and {2} are formatted amounts, like €1 and €500

onb_stripe.description: Small line under the amounts: the payment happens on Stripe's secure page

onb_done_title.description: Heading of the onboarding done screen

onb_pin_line.en: Pin the icon to start a session anytime.
onb_pin_line.fr: Épingle l'icône pour lancer une session à tout moment.
onb_pin_line.description: Done screen line: pin the extension icon in the Chrome toolbar to start focus sessions

onb_pin_hint.description: Screen reader text of the tiny drawing under the pin line: click Chrome's puzzle icon, then the pin next to the extension

onb_try_session.description: Done screen main button that starts a focus session. {1} is 10

onb_focus_until.description: Done screen button label once the session has started. {1} is a time, e.g. 14:10

onb_missing_one.description: Done screen line before an Allow link: one chosen site lacks access, so it is blocked with Chrome's error page instead of the goal page

onb_missing_many.description: Done screen line before an Allow link: {1} chosen sites (2 or more) lack access, so they are blocked with Chrome's error page instead of the goal page

onb_goal_custom.description: Last choice of the goal step: reveals a text field.

onb_goal_empty.en: Write your goal, or pick one above.
onb_goal_empty.fr: Écris ton objectif, ou choisis-en un au-dessus.
onb_goal_empty.description: Error when the custom goal is empty.

onb_money_why.en: A small price makes you pause and think twice.
onb_money_why.fr: Un petit prix pour marquer une pause et réfléchir.
onb_money_why.description: Explains why money helps (onboarding, money mode).

onb_money_skip.en: Skipping for free is always possible.
onb_money_skip.description: Says clearly that paying is never required.
